statement: >= 15 distinct organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run (shared with I-N-01; counted once per family) (Epoch AI; 2027-12-31)
counting_note: Per owner ruling 2026-11-17 (adjudications.md), I-R5-01 and I-N-01 are merged and I-N-01 is canonical. The items below mirror 2025/I-N-01.json (see duplicate_of) and must NOT be counted as separate evidence.
status_at_phase_end: Not met: 2 distinct organisations (both Bloc A) known above 1e26 FLOP at end-2025, against a threshold of 15. Late-2025 flagships of other Bloc A developers lacked compute estimates, so 2 is a floor. Bloc B flagships were estimated at ~3-5e24.

items.summary: A Bloc A developer released the first model estimated above 1e26 FLOP (~3.5e26); organisation count 1.
items.detail: xAI Grok 3; Epoch 'How many AI models will exceed compute thresholds?' (2025-05-30).

items.summary: A second Bloc A developer released a model estimated at 3.8e26 FLOP; organisation count 2.
Leading Bloc B open-weight releases of 2025 were estimated at ~3-5e24 FLOP, ~20-30x below threshold; no third organisation was publicly estimated above 1e26 during 2025.
items.detail: Epoch estimates for DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-235B, Kimi K2 (Thinking), DeepSeek-V3.2; entry dates of estimates not verified.

items.summary: Late-2025 flagships of three other Bloc A developers had no compute estimate, so the count of 2 is a floor.
items.detail: Epoch entries Gemini 3 Pro (compute unknown), Claude Opus 4.5 ('very likely >1e25').
